MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #10
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 8 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 19
   C. 88
   D. 38

2. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 8 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 23
   B. 30
   C. 46
   D. 120

3. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 31.6
   C. 31
   D. 31.7

4. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19.6
   B. 19.7
   C. 19
   D. 25

5. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. 2/2
   C. They are equal
   D. Cannot tell

6. What is √16? (1 mark)
   A. 8
   B. 16
   C. 4
   D. 5

7. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15.7
   B. 15
   C. 21
   D. 15.6

8. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 27 cm³
   B. 9 cm³
   C. 18 cm³
   D. 12 cm³

9. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23
   B. 23.7
   C. 29
   D. 23.6

10. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x
   B. 6x
   C. 6x + 2
   D. 12x + 2

11. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 2/3
   B. 1/2
   C. 3/4
   D. 1/4

12. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 25
   D. 1

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
